footprint.definition: The mark a foot leaves in soft ground. Big animals leave big footprints, and they show which way the animal walked.
footprint.example: The footprints pointed deeper into the valley.

multi_agent_system.definition: A setup in which several specialized AI agents divide a task among themselves and pass work along.

pedal.definition: The flat part of a bicycle that your foot stands on. When you push the pedals, the wheels turn.
pedal.example: The pedals were stiff, so he pushed them three times.

rooftop.definition: The flat top of a building. In the old quarter, the rooftops are close enough to almost touch.
rooftop.example: They landed on the roof garden above the old house.

square.definition: A shape with four equal sides and four corners. A cracker is a square.
square.example: The floor tile is a square.
